About

I've been editing for close to 7–8 years, and for the last few of those I've wanted to take it seriously and do it full-time. My approach leans on storytelling, flow, and viewer retention rather than leading with flashy cuts and effects — though I'm comfortable doing that style too when a project calls for it.

I stepped back from editing for a while to focus on school. That's finished now, so I'm free to put real time into this. My portfolio is smaller than I'd like as a result — the work below is what I have to show for it so far, and it's growing again.
